gloss_text: How was your recent ride? Rate your driver and win points.
Reliance share reached your target price. Open the app for details.
Bitcoin rose 5% in the last hour. Tap to set a price alert.
Market closed 0.4% higher today. Your portfolio summary arrives at 8 pm.
The stock market opens at 9:15 am today. Read the pre-market news.
A share you hold fell 3%. The market says this is normal fluctuation.
This week your crypto holdings rose 1.2%. The full report comes on Sunday.
Live Caption is turned on. The Bengali language pack finished downloading.
Live captions are paused. Tap here to resume.
Sound notifications are now off. Go to settings to turn alarm sounds back on.
Speech recognition now runs in English. Open settings to change the language.
Caption language change is complete. Speech will now appear as Bengali text.
Live Caption turned off by itself because the battery is low. Charge the phone and turn it back on.

Rahul: Last night a cat had kittens in our building parking 😂 / Mita: Yes, I saw them too, they look lovely. / Karim: How about a tea gathering on Saturday? Someone bring snacks. / Mita: Okay, I'll bring biscuits.
Forward this to everyone! Someone said free nutrition tablets will be given to children tomorrow at 6 am. I don't know if it's true. Share it, may everyone be well!
Dear residents, a general meeting will be held this Sunday at 5 pm in the club hall. We will discuss collecting funds for water tank repair. Everyone please attend.
Urgent! The electrical box in block C has caught fire and there is a lot of smoke. Everyone leave now by the stairs. Do not use the lift. The guards are coming.
A visitor is waiting at your gate. Name: Rajesh, parcel delivery. Tap in the app to allow or deny. If you don't reply it will be cancelled automatically.

Suman: The lift is off again 😩 / Anik: I was stuck in the lift for a long time this morning, I was really scared / Suman: Did you tell the owner? / Anik: Yes, they said a technician will come tomorrow.
Good morning everyone! May today be filled with love and joy. If you send this to ten people your day will go well. Let nobody be left out, bring a little joy to everyone.
Maintenance notice: water supply will be off on Thursday from 10 am to 1 pm. Please store water in advance. Residents of all flats in the building should avoid laundry and bathing during this time.
There is a flood risk in this area. Avoid low roads and move to higher ground now. Wait for further warnings. Take children and elderly people to a safe place first.
Someone is at the door. The camera shows the milkman standing with a bicycle. You can check the live view. This is a regular visit.

Sabir: Everyone bring name stickers tomorrow 😊 / Nasrin: Okay, the little one wants coloured paper / Sabir: I'll buy it, no problem / Nasrin: Thanks brother! Shall we go to the beach on Saturday? / Sabir: Definitely, at 7 am.
Share this right away: a friend said city buses will not run tonight. It is not confirmed; if anyone confirms it, let us know and share it.
Local gardening meetup this Saturday at 7 am in the park. There is also a litter clean-up drive. Come on time and bring gloves!
Urgent: a gas leak has been found in the city. Turn off gas stoves and open the windows. Do not touch electric switches. If you must go out, follow the guard's instructions.
Your friend Binoy has come to the gate. Will you let the visitor in? This is a regular visit, not urgent. Tap to decline, or else wait.
Robi: Yesterday's match was great! Our team won 🏏 / Arif: You hit a six in the last over, amazing / Robi: Ha ha, all by God's grace / Arif: Shall we play another team next week? Tell me who's coming.
